asked: Please give the complete list of every orders-table row (order_id, customer_id, order_date) whose order_date falls in 2026-06-11 to 2026-07-11 inclusive, regardless of region, and then mark which ones belong to a South customer — I want to confirm no in-range South row was omitted (e.g. any C106 row, since the draft reports zero for C106, and any second C102 or C109 row).

The draft deduplicates O2702 (listed under C107). Confirm whether the raw row count in that date window for South customers is 17 before dedup and 16 after, and state whether any other duplicated order_id (O2406, O2181) falls inside the window.

For the two boundary dates, state which rows sit exactly on 2026-06-11 and on 2026-07-11, and confirm the inclusive treatment applied to each (the draft counts O2881 on 2026-06-11; is there anything dated 2026-07-11, such as O2446?).
replies: Yes. Raw South in-range row count is 17 before dedup: C100 2, C101 1, C102 1, C103 4, C105 3, C106 0, C107 5 (O2702 appears twice), C109 1. After counting duplicate O2702 once, C107 drops to 4 and the total is 16. O2406 has both rows dated 2026-04-28, outside the window. O2181 has both rows dated 2026-05-12, outside the window. The only duplicated order_id inside the window is O2702, both dated 2026-07-01.

Exactly on 2026-06-11: O2881 C103 South and O2328 C104 non-South. Inclusive treatment counts O2881 in the South total; O2328 is not South. Exactly on 2026-07-11: O2446 C108 non-South only. It is inside the inclusive window but is not South, so it does not affect the South count. There is no South row dated 2026-07-11.
